name: Minds 4: share remembering and wealth advantage under the planner
description: The mean wealth advantage of rememberers over everyone else on goap-truffles's world (hidden truffle spots, walking, 200-tick memory span, GOAP instead of rule M) against the share of newborns that remember: 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 0.9. Seeds 1–20, ticks 500, measured over ticks 200–500. For comparison with Minds 3's mem-share.
